notes: Three 60-second points: 21G per direction, unlimited, 21G return. Five daemon-only SIGUSR1 samples per point, about ten seconds apart. Diagnostic harness patch: recovery-live-snapshots.patch.
No local compilation, local kernel tests or Git packing overlapped measurement. Migration diagnostics ran on a separate test machine.
This is an instrumented observation, not an isolated speed comparison. Signal-driven snapshot formatting can perturb scheduling.
An excluded pilot signaled receivers during load. Their two-sample storage truncated the goodput interval to ten seconds. Corrected runs signal receivers only before load and after send completion.
The six expiry subsets exactly sum to expired_frames. Fully sent expiry can follow successful TAP delivery; partial expiry only bounds potential orphan creation.
recovery_cleanup_peak is a lifetime maximum gauge, not a delta or sum. Other counter deltas include drain. Goodput excludes drain. CPU100% means one core.
No corrupt, duplicate, wrong-run or too-old inner records; no inner UDP errors, outer UDP errors, socket overflow or outer fragments. Reordering is reported.
The container cgroup reports cpu.max=max and zero throttling. This does not inspect every ancestor's CPU restrictions.
